items.prompt:
Artificial selection is when:
A) The environment selects traits
B) Humans choose which organisms reproduce
C) Traits appear randomly
D) Nothing is selected
items.answer: B) Humans choose which organisms reproduce

steps: Humans select the breeding organisms in artificial selection.

items.prompt:
Which is an example of artificial selection?
A) Wild beetles hiding from birds
B) A farmer breeding cows for more milk
C) A fossil forming
D) An earthquake
items.answer: B) A farmer breeding cows for more milk

steps: Breeding cows for more milk is human-directed selection.

items.prompt:
In artificial selection, who does the selecting?
A) The weather
B) Humans
C) Predators
D) No one

steps: Humans choose the traits in artificial selection.

items.prompt:
How is artificial selection like natural selection?
A) Both change populations by selecting which traits are passed on
B) Both are done by the environment
C) Neither changes populations
D) Both are random
items.answer: A) Both change populations by selecting which traits are passed on

steps: Both act on heritable traits over generations.

items.prompt:
How is artificial selection different from natural selection?
A) Humans do the selecting instead of the environment
B) It never changes traits
C) It happens in one day
D) It needs no reproduction
items.answer: A) Humans do the selecting instead of the environment

steps: The selector is human rather than the environment.

items.prompt:
Which technology lets humans change inherited traits most directly?
A) Genetic engineering
B) A telescope
C) A microscope
D) A thermometer

A farmer plants seeds only from the biggest tomatoes for many years. The best prediction is:
A) Tomatoes get smaller
B) Tomatoes get larger over generations
C) No change ever
D) Tomatoes become animals
items.answer: B) Tomatoes get larger over generations

steps: Selecting the largest fruit each generation increases size over time.

items.prompt:
Why does artificial selection usually take several generations to change a population?
A) Traits must be passed to offspring repeatedly to build up the change
B) Humans forget each year
C) Traits change instantly
D) Reproduction is not involved
items.answer: A) Traits must be passed to offspring repeatedly to build up the change

steps: Change accumulates as the selected trait is inherited over generations.
